citation.title: Determination of Ion Temperature and Toroidal Rotation Velocity via Charge-Exchange Recombination Spectroscopy
citation.authors: Hiroaki Ogawa; Yukitoshi Miura; Satoshi Kasai

topic: Early CXRS measurement of ion temperature and toroidal rotation on JFT-2M from H-alpha and C VI (n=7-6) lines during NBI
own_question: Can CXRS give localized, time-resolved Ti and relative rotation in JFT-2M?
actual_method_and_evidence: Single-monochromator, photomultiplier, shot-to-shot wavelength scans. H-alpha required bi-Gaussian unfolding of cold and hot components. C VI profiles were fitted with a single Gaussian at r=0 and ±0.1 m. C VI Ti agreed with NPA within the stated error after a fine-structure correction. Relative rotation saturated near 5.4e4 m/s at the center. Profiles required 10-15 discharges. The authors also report an instrumental 0.3 ms amplifier response, but data were plotted at 5 ms intervals.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Carbon CXRS infers impurity-ion temperature from Doppler width of a charge-exchange-excited C VI line, localized at beam-sightline intersection; this underlies conventional CES labels.
claim_checks.qualification: Measures C6+ temperature; equating with main-ion Ti is an assumption. Shown on JFT-2M, not KSTAR.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reported CES temperature depends on processing choices (instrument width, l-mixing fine-structure correction, Gaussian fit), so labels are processed estimates rather than independent truth.
claim_checks.qualification: Correction factors were taken from cited prior work. Cross-check against NPA agreed within error, with CXRS somewhat lower, which the authors attribute to plasma shift.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Offline, multi-shot profile assembly. No real-time reporting, no report latency, and no BES/ECEI. The 0.3 ms figure is amplifier response, not report availability.
validation_if_relevant: Comparison with NPA within experimental error only; no statistical split.
forbidden_inferences: DOIs of cited references belong to this paper
reason_to_include_or_exclude: A historical, concrete basis for carbon CES Ti labels and their processing-dependence. It is background only; it does not bear on nowcasting.
